page.layout: One printed page, title page. Text in centred lines from top to bottom; a woodcut vignette in the centre below the text; publisher and date lines at the foot. Handwritten inscriptions at right and left (not transcribed).

main_text.l: EX DEI VERBO, S. PATRVM MONUMENTIS, Dd. Scholasticis & Physicis, cum veteribus, tum recentioribus, concinnatus, & in duas partes distinctus.
Liber lectu plane dignus, utilis, iucundus & suauis, & ob argumenti magnitudinem scitu omnino necessarius.

page.notes: Woodcut vignette (allegorical female figure with caduceus within a decorative frame) between the description and the imprint; not transcribed. Handwritten ownership inscriptions in ink at right ("Sum ... Georgii ... Wattendorffensis ... 1695") and near the left of the descriptive lines ("Sorkes ... in manu") are manuscript, not printed. Dates in the imprint read as printed, "XCVII". Some letters in the top lines are rendered in long-s style and are copied as plain s.
